name: Documented business justification and use case description
description: A written one-pager describing the problem, the proposed AI approach, and why it is needed, filed with the intake record.

name: Data inventory and sensitivity classification sign-off
description: The business owner and a data steward confirm exactly which data fields flow into the system and that the declared sensitivity tier is accurate.

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) review
description: Legal/privacy review of the data processing agreement with any external party that will receive, host, or train on company data.

name: Human-in-the-loop review of outputs before external use
description: A qualified human reviews and approves system outputs before they reach an external user or are acted upon externally.

name: External legal review of training/data sourcing
description: Outside counsel or the legal team reviews the provenance and licensing of any data used to train, fine-tune, or ground the model.

name: Security architecture review (access control, encryption, logging)
description: Security reviews authentication, authorization, encryption in transit/at rest, and audit logging for the system before launch.

name: Model/vendor security and privacy due diligence questionnaire
description: The model or platform provider completes a standard security and privacy questionnaire, reviewed by security and privacy.

name: Bias, fairness, and disparate-impact evaluation
description: A documented evaluation of the system's outputs across protected classes or user segments before it can influence decisions about people.

name: Documented incident response and rollback / kill-switch plan
description: A written plan for how the team detects, contains, and reverts a bad model behavior in production, including who can pull the kill switch.

name: Ongoing performance and drift monitoring plan
description: A defined cadence and owner for checking that the system's real-world performance and error rate have not drifted from evaluation-time results.

name: AI-use disclosure to end users or affected individuals
description: End users or affected individuals are told, in plain language, that AI is involved in producing the content or decision they are seeing.

name: Privacy impact assessment (PIA/DPIA)
description: A formal privacy impact assessment covering lawful basis, data minimization, and individual rights, completed before launch.

name: Records retention and audit logging policy
description: A documented retention schedule for inputs, outputs, and decision logs, consistent with company records-management policy.

name: Governance committee review and named executive sign-off
description: A cross-functional AI governance committee (not just the accountable stakeholders in the RACI) formally reviews the request and a named executive signs off before any further work proceeds. This is the 'formal review' that a Restricted-tier request is pending until completed.

name: Independent third-party or internal-audit assessment
description: An assessment by a party outside the requesting team (internal audit, an outside firm, or an independent second-line function) evaluates the use case's risk controls before launch is authorized.
